questions.question: The shorthand 'transition: all 0.3s ease' sets, in order:
questions.explanation: transition shorthand order is property duration timing-function delay (duration is required; others optional).

questions.question: Which is REQUIRED for a transition to occur?
questions.explanation: Without duration > 0 the change is instant. Timing-function and delay are optional with defaults.

questions.question: transition-delay: 0.5s means the transition:

options.text: Starts half a second AFTER the property change

questions.explanation: delay postpones the start; duration sets length. They are separate components of the shorthand.

questions.question: transition-timing-function: ease is a:

options.text: Preset curve that starts slow, speeds up, ends slow

questions.explanation: ease is the default; linear is constant; ease-in/out/inception curves vary. cubic-bezier gives full control.

questions.question: To animate on page load you should use:

options.text: An animation, not a transition (transitions need a trigger/change)

questions.explanation: Transitions only run on a value change; for entrance animations on load, keyframe animations (or toggling a class via JS) are needed.

questions.question: transition: none disables:

options.text: All transitions so changes are instant

questions.explanation: transition: none removes the transition entirely — useful to disable motion (e.g. under reduced-motion).

questions.question: Transitioning 'height: auto' is problematic because:

options.text: auto is not animatable; you need a fixed height or max-height technique

questions.explanation: auto has no intermediate value to interpolate. Animate max-height (to a safe upper bound) or use grid 0fr→1fr / JS for collapsing.

questions.question: Combining transitions with :focus-visible improves:

options.text: Keyboard accessibility (smooth cues only for keyboard users)

questions.explanation: :focus-visible shows focus rings for keyboard nav (not mouse), so transitioned focus styles aid a11y without noise for mouse users.
